query_contract.sql_utf8: SELECT l.vote_event_id,l.initiative_id,l.link_method,l.confidence,l.evidence_json,v.vote_date,v.legislature,v.session_number,v.vote_number,v.title,v.totals_present,v.totals_yes,v.totals_no,v.totals_abstain,v.totals_no_vote,v.totals_absent,json_extract(v.raw_payload,'$.totals_absent') AS raw_totals_absent,v.source_id,sr.source_record_id,sr.source_snapshot_date,sr.content_sha256 FROM parl_vote_event_initiatives l JOIN parl_vote_events v USING(vote_event_id) JOIN source_records sr ON sr.source_record_pk=v.source_record_pk WHERE l.initiative_id=? AND v.source_id=? AND sr.source_snapshot_date=? ORDER BY v.vote_date,v.session_number,v.vote_number,l.vote_event_id

query_contract.definitions_and_releases_sql_utf8: SELECT d.indicator_id,d.source_id,d.dataset_code,d.indicator_code,d.frequency_code,d.unit_code,d.methodology_version,d.revision_policy,r.indicator_release_id,r.source_snapshot_date,r.source_updated_at,r.source_url,r.source_content_sha256,r.source_bytes,r.comparison_state FROM indicator_definitions d JOIN indicator_releases r USING(indicator_id) WHERE r.indicator_release_id=? ORDER BY d.indicator_id,r.indicator_release_id
query_contract.series_sql_utf8: SELECT indicator_series_version_id,indicator_id,indicator_release_id,stable_series_key,geography_code,geography_name,geography_system,geography_level,geography_version,dimensions_json FROM indicator_series_versions WHERE indicator_release_id=? ORDER BY indicator_id,stable_series_key,indicator_series_version_id
query_contract.observations_sql_utf8: SELECT o.indicator_observation_version_id,o.period_label,o.period_start,o.period_end,o.value_decimal,o.value_text,o.source_status_code,o.uncertainty_state,o.revision_ordinal,o.revision_state,o.raw_cell_index,o.raw_value_json,e.indicator_observation_evidence_id,e.source_content_sha256,e.raw_path,e.value_json_pointer,e.status_json_pointer FROM indicator_observation_versions o JOIN indicator_observation_evidence e USING(indicator_observation_version_id) WHERE o.indicator_series_version_id=? AND o.indicator_release_id=? ORDER BY o.period_start,o.revision_ordinal DESC,o.indicator_observation_version_id

preimage.observation_role_projection: strict_pre_eligible if period_end < action_date; strict_post_eligible if period_start > action_date; otherwise overlap_excluded

reader_wording.status_label: Candidato preproducción pendiente de revisión humana
reader_wording.summary: Este emparejamiento usa una votación real del Senado y observaciones reales de Eurostat. Es un candidato metodológico L1, no un enlace de resultado publicado.
reader_wording.measurement: Eurostat registra 28.700 PPS por habitante para España en 2019 y 28.300 en 2021. La diferencia aritmética es -400. El año 2020 queda excluido porque su intervalo contiene la fecha de la votación.
reader_wording.warning: No usar para afirmar asociación estadística, causalidad o efecto; atribuir resultados; clasificar actores; asignar mérito o culpa; ni evaluar éxito, fracaso, legalidad o corrupción.

limitations: The 2020 annual observation overlaps the 2020-10-07 action date and is excluded from pre/post roles.
The retained observations span the COVID-19 pandemic and many unmeasured political, social, demographic, and economic changes.
One pre point and one post point do not establish statistical association, trend break, counterfactual, or causal effect.
No human semantic or geography review has been recorded.
The current Eurostat release is a baseline capture; a later real release is required to demonstrate supersession.
The original vote-specific XML bytes are not independently content-addressed; only the normalized official source record is content-addressed.
A vote on the remainder of a bill is not proof of implementation, collection, compliance, fiscal yield, economic effect, or social outcome.

limitations: The 2020 annual observation overlaps the 2020-10-07 action date and is excluded from pre/post roles.
The retained observations span the COVID-19 pandemic and many unmeasured political, social, demographic, and economic changes.
One pre point and one post point do not establish statistical association, trend break, counterfactual, or causal effect.
No human semantic or geography review has been recorded.
The current Eurostat release is a baseline capture; a later real release is required to demonstrate supersession.
The original vote-specific XML bytes are not independently content-addressed; only the normalized official source record is content-addressed.
A vote on the remainder of a bill is not proof of implementation, collection, compliance, fiscal yield, economic effect, or social outcome.
